inline_text:
## Problem

`Web Banner.png` (the square "AAIF Community Events / <City>" image in every chapter folder) has the city drawn into the pixels. `create_chapter.py` rebrands OOXML text, so it copied TemplateCity's PNG byte for byte. Measured 2026-11-03: 37 chapters' banners were byte-identical to the template and said "San Francisco", including the two created this week. Renamed chapters (Japan, New Zealand, Edinburgh, and others) still showed their old names.

## Fix

- `render_web_banner.py` makes the banner from the fourth slide of the chapter's own `Banners (…)/Square Logo.pptx`. That slide is the same 2000x2000 composition, already rebranded, in the design system. It renders through `slides_export.render_slide_png` (Google's renderer, no LibreOffice).
- **Guards**
  - The slide must say exactly "AAIF Community Events" plus the chapter's name. This is checked on the deck (slide resolved by presentation order) and again on the page the renderer draws.
  - The banner is stamped with the deck's `md5Checksum` plus the chapter name in `appProperties`, so a re-run skips current banners and re-checks after any deck change or rename.
  - The stamp is written after the upload. A temp Slides copy that can't be trashed fails the chapter.
  - A sweep never creates a banner and skips TemplateCity unless it is named. `--chapter X --create` creates one. It is the follow-up `create_chapter` prints when its render failed before the file existed.
  - A folder with no banner counts as absent, not failed, even when it has no Banners folder or deck.
- `slides_export.render_slide_png` gains `check_text` and `strict_cleanup`, a PNG signature check and clearer errors. `strict_cleanup` puts a stray copy's id in the error even when the render also failed. Existing callers are unchanged.
- `create_chapter` calls it after a clean write (exit 2 if the banner failed). It does not render a dirty existing deck under `--resume`. `rename_chapter` calls it after a verified write (exit 1 if it failed, and it never creates a banner).
- Docs: the SKILL.md verify step and gotcha. `references/rename-chapter.md` lists what a text rename misses.

## Verification

- New `test_render_web_banner.py` (45 tests), new renderer guard tests in the library suite (604 passed), and new hook tests in `test_create_chapter.py` (79) and `test_rename_chapter.py`, including `main()` wiring. The NO_RETRY create is counted at the subprocess. Two mutants confirmed the new tests catch a dropped NO_RETRY and a report run that writes. Pre-commit is clean.
- A live report over 120 folders found 119 to render and 0 refused. Tatooine has no banner and is listed.
- A live `--write` on Aarhus rendered the right name at 2000x2000, left no temp copy, and re-runs as current.
- The estate-wide `--write` ran on 2026-11-03: 118 rendered, 1 already current (Aarhus), 0 failed. Tatooine has no banner and was left alone.
